Council approves new cycle lanes for the city centre

By Jane Example, Transport Correspondent
24 September 2026

The city council has approved plans for three kilometres of segregated cycle lanes, linking the railway station to the university campus.

Councillors voted twenty-one to nine in favour of the scheme, which will cost £4.2 million and is due to open next spring.

An artist’s impression of the new lanes on Station Road.

Opponents argued that the loss of on-street parking would harm local traders, but the transport committee said footfall surveys showed most shoppers arrive on foot or by bus.

Construction is expected to begin in January, with temporary closures on Station Road announced nearer the time.
